values: AMS Workflow vs Standard Odoo 18 Enterprise Mapping
Use standard Odoo apps and configuration first: Accounting, Sales/CRM, Purchase, Inventory, Barcode, MRP, Quality, Maintenance, Budget, Project, Delivery, Fleet and Spreadsheet dashboards.
Several needs are company-specific KPIs or control policies: budget lock, supplier scorecard, DPPM, cash forecast, cost variance allocation and external forecast/PO import.
Custom only reports, validation, integrations and approval guards that standard Odoo does not cover after configuration.
Do not custom-post stock valuation or accounting entries with SQL. Design FIFO/AVCO, WIP and COGS policy before go-live.

values: Financial report by Business unit ( Segment)/Branch สามารถแสดงรายงานได้ทั้งแบบ branch แบบ กลุ่มธุรกิจ
แสดงรายงาน หรือ Dashboard
Analytic Accounting, multi-company, accounting reports, spreadsheet dashboards. AMS has Business Unit and Branch analytic plans.
Use analytic dimensions first. Custom only if Branch/BU must become hard mandatory fields on every transaction.
Finance Analysis report ( Finance Ratio , Quick ratio, EBITDA…)
Financial statements, accounting reports, spreadsheet dashboards, pivots and export can support management ratios.
Company-specific ratio formulas and auto-refresh packs should be implemented as spreadsheet dashboard or custom report.
This checkout does not expose a dedicated consolidation app. Standard coverage is multi-company, inter-company rules and spreadsheet/report consolidation.
Statutory consolidation with eliminations, ownership percentage and translation adjustments needs custom or external consolidation design.
- ระบบ bank มี การทำ bank reconfile อย่างไรหาก upload ข้อมูลจาก Ibanking และเช็คยอด บัญชี ธนาคาร แยกประเภท แสดงเป็น cny
Bank journals, statement imports, reconciliation widget and multi-currency AR/AP/BANK are standard.
Map the real bank file format. A non-standard bank format may need an import connector/template.
- สามารถพยากรณ์ การใช้เงินที่คาดว่าจะเกิดจากการเปิด PR PO AP(due) และเงินคาดว่าจะรับ AR
AP/AR due dates and payment terms are standard. PO commitments exist in purchase data.
A single cash forecast combining PR, PO, AP due and AR expected receipts needs a custom dashboard/report.
Budgeting and controlling system ( Budget limit)
มีการ Alert หรือ lock ได้หากเกิน budget  และแสดงการทำงานการกรอก budgetฝ่ายต่างๆ
Budgets and analytic budgets are standard. AMS has account_budget installed and analytic dimensions configured.
Alert/lock PR or PO over budget requires approval rule, automated action or custom constraint.
Capital Budget System ( Investment and Project)
กรณี การเก็บค่าใช้จ่ายรายโปรเจค
Project plus analytic accounting and budget can track investment/capital spending.
Multi-step CAPEX approval or automatic asset capitalization may need extra workflow design.
แสดงรายงาน หรือ Dashboard
BoM cost, work center cost, manufacturing accounting and stock valuation provide the data source.
MRP Accounting, Stock Accounting, Spreadsheet Dashboard
Detailed standard-vs-actual variance by operation, yield and waste should be a custom dashboard/report.
Cost Variance allocation to COG , Inventory and value of WIP
แสดงวิธีการทำงาน cost allocate ไปยัง ต้นทุนขาย หรือ สต๊อก FG , WIP
Stock valuation supports FIFO, AVCO and standard cost; MRP accounting posts production values.
Variance allocation to COGS, FG inventory and WIP is accounting-sensitive and needs a controlled custom design.
WIP report ( In case of no location) ไม่ได้กำหนดให้เป็น  stock แต่ tracking จำนวน มูลค่าได้
แสดงรายงาน WIP ที่ค้างผลิตอยู่ใน แต่ละขั้นตอนการผลิต ทั้งจำนวนและ มูลค่า
MRP and work orders track production progress; valuation by stock move/location is standard.
WIP quantity/value by process without stock locations needs a custom report from MO, WO and cost data.

Multicurrency in each collection of AR AP and  BANK สามารถจัดเก็บ ข้อมูลบัญชีได้หลากหลายสกุลเงิน เช่นซื้อ หยวน ตั้งหนี้หยวน หรือ ขาย JPY ลูกหนี้ JPY เก็บเงินเข้า ธนาคาร เป็น JPY เนื่องจากบริษัท มีการฝากเงินในสกุลต่างๆ
1. ซื้อ PR (Budget control) -> PO -> AP -> Payment ( CNY currency)
Multi-currency AR/AP/BANK is standard. AMS activated THB, CNY, EUR, JPY, SGD and USD.
Configure exchange rates and bank journals per currency before live operation.
Quotation Function and Measuring Success ( win rate : quoted vs won )
** แสดง Quotation โดยดึงจาก BOM -temp ได้ เพื่อให้ sale มีหลักการคิดต้นทุนได้เบื้องต้น
CRM opportunities, quotations, sales analysis and won/lost status are standard. AMS has quotation S00001.
Auto costing quotation from BOM template is a custom/PLM design if the structure must be controlled.
SO integrated with Customer 's PO ( Auto motive) and MRP/ Forecast ( + stock require )
สามารถแสดง quotation ที่เสนอสามารถนำมาเปิด SO ได้ อัตราแค่ไหน win rate
Customer reference on SO, routes, replenishment and MRP demand integration are standard.
Automotive customer PO or rolling forecast file import may require EDI/import custom work.
Outgoing performance ( % non fulfilment " request vs delivery " )
ข้อนี้อยากรู้ว่าที่ forcast มา แล้ว ได้ invoice ไปจริงๆเท่าไหร่ เป็น %
Delivery status, invoice status, sales analysis and stock picking data are standard.
Forecast-to-invoice and request-vs-delivery percentages need a company-specific KPI definition.
Sale by Business Unit and GP
Sales analysis plus margin modules and analytic dimensions support GP by BU.
Make BU analytic mandatory if management reports must always reconcile.
Branch GP can use analytic Branch or company/warehouse structure.
A hard Branch field on all flows needs custom field/rules if analytic dimensions are not enough.
Sale forecast link to MRP in order to forecast Matetial
SO demand, replenishment, MPS/MRP and forecasted inventory are standard.
Complex customer forecast import or seasonality logic may need custom import/dashboard.
SO by MOQ controlling ( Link with BOM ( by master unit ) , store ( by STD Unit ) and Purchasing unit (by min q'ty " unique & common )
UoM, sales quantity, vendor minimum quantity, packaging and reordering multiples are standard pieces.
Blocking SO by MOQ across master, stock and purchase units needs custom validation.
Contract agrrememnt & framework  ( by business unit )
Quotation templates, pricelists, analytic BU and recurring contract options cover part of the need.
Sales framework agreement by BU may need a custom contract model if templates are insufficient.
CRM ( customer -  mission & vision , strategy , organization , performance  )
CRM and Contacts can store customer profile, activities, notes, tags and opportunities.
Structured mission, vision, strategy and performance fields may need Studio/custom fields.
Other else. That system will offer
Useful standard add-ons include activities, quotation templates, pricelists, dashboards and spreadsheet analysis.
Define the exact use case before custom work.
Quotation system ( RM , SEMI , TRADING ) and Measuring selection ( win rate : quotation vs target price  )
RFQ, purchase agreements, vendor pricelists and purchase analysis are standard. AMS has RFQ P00002 and BO00001.
Target price scoring or vendor win-rate needs a custom scorecard/report.
Vendor data, PO history, receipt history and price records provide the standard data source.
Weighted supplier scorecard needs custom dashboard/report.
( Delivery on time , Low price, credit longterm ,…)
Scheduled dates, receipt dates, payment terms and purchase prices are standard.
Define scoring thresholds for delivery, price and credit before building reports.
Purchase analysis and vendor pricelist history support basic cost trend review.
Cost movement by item/vendor/period versus target/last purchase needs a custom dashboard/report.
Integrate with MRP and SO about MOQ,lead time of supplier
Vendor lead time, vendor minimum quantity, reordering rules and MRP procurement are standard.
Requires complete supplierinfo, routes and lead-time master data.
PR and PO approval process ( make analysis data / suggestion )
Approvals app, purchase approval and RFQ/PO workflow are standard. AMS has purchase request approval category.
Auto suggestion before approval using budget/vendor score needs custom logic.
Purchase Agreements and Blanket Orders are standard. AMS has BO00001.
Configure approval, expiry and price-break policy.
Other else. That system will offer
Additional standard options include vendor pricelists, 3-way matching, replenishment and purchase dashboards.
Lots/serials, traceability and stock moves are standard. AMS products use lot tracking where relevant.
Set tracking policy and label policy per product.
Storage locations, shelves, putaway rules and removal strategies are standard. AMS has shelf/QC/WIP locations.
Advanced capacity or bin optimization may need WMS customization.
การทำงานระบบ Barcode อย่างไร ในการซื้อ จัดเก็บ เบิก ใช้ อุปกรณ์อย่างไร ต้อง add on หรือ อยู่ในระบบเดียวกัน
Barcode app supports receipts, delivery, inventory and production/quality bridge modules.
Test real scanners, labels and mobile devices.
Integrate with MRP/Forecast ,SO and PO about minimum Stock ,Slow and Dead stock
Forecasted inventory, replenishment and reordering rules are standard. AMS has RM1 min/max rule.
Slow/dead stock aging and turnover dashboard needs a custom/spreadsheet KPI.
Reordering Rules support min, max, multiple quantity, trigger and warehouse.
Routes, delivery methods and Fleet provide standard coverage for logistics basics.
Driver evaluation and ticket workflow need custom or Helpdesk/Project integration.
MRP/Forecast Integration Purchase (PO) and SO , Stock ( FG + WIP )
การทำงานระบบคุณภาพ ในแต่ละขั้นตอนการผลิต จนถึง final to stock
MRP, work orders, replenishment, SO demand and purchase procurement are standard. AMS has MO WH/MO/00001.
Requires routes, BoM, work centers and lead times before go-live.
Work orders track consumed quantity, produced quantity, duration, scrap and productivity.
Detailed waste and downtime reasons may need extra fields/report.
Shop Floor Management ( Tracking status of products)
Shop Floor and Work Orders track status by operation. AMS has 7 work centers and 21 operations.
Validate tablet/operator flow on the shop floor.
Overall production effectiveness(OPE) " availability , performance rate , quality performance "
Work center reports and productivity data support availability/performance/quality data sources.
OPE formula is company-specific and should be custom/spreadsheet dashboard.
Overall equipment  effectiveness(OEE) " availability , performance rate , quality performance "
OEE target, time efficiency and workorder productivity are standard concepts.
Configure work center capacity, time efficiency and downtime capture.
BoM, components and operations are standard. AMS has BOM AMS.400 REV 00 with 21 routing operations.
Create semi-finished products and child BoMs for full multi-level production.
BOM version for Quotation and PPAP
PLM/ECO and BoM revisions are standard. AMS has mrp_plm installed.
Quotation BOM and PPAP document workflow may need custom process or Documents/Sign integration.
Barcode System for tracking in each process of production
Barcode MRP and Barcode Quality MRP bridge modules support scan points in production/quality.
Design barcode labels and scan points per operation.
Quality Checks, Quality Alerts and Returns provide the data source.
DPPM formula by customer/product/period needs custom dashboard/report.
